meta.source: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), via Overpass — temple boundaries and building footprints
meta.note: Compound parts are composed from the mapped boundary using a walled-axial grammar (gate on the south end of the axis, courtyard, main hall at the north end, flanking side halls, a tower on the axis). Parts marked origin=measured are OpenStreetMap footprints; parts marked origin=model are the grammar's placement and dimensions. The roofs in meta.roofs are the compound's pitched gables — the hall, the side halls and the gate — and every one of them is the grammar's, not a survey's.

roofs.note: Pitched roofs for the temple compounds, in the column order of public/data/cnx/roofs-temple.json: lon, lat, length, width, rotation, eaves, rise, kind, group, category. kind and category are indices; group 2 is temple.
